Have you ever kept trying, even when nobody listened? Today's story is about a man who kept trying... for nine hundred and fifty years! This is the story of Prophet Nuh, peace be upon him, and the great ark, from the Holy Quran.

Long, long ago, people lived in a beautiful land full of gardens and rivers. But they forgot Allah, the One who gave them everything. They made statues of stone, and named them Wadd, Suwa, Yaghuth, Yauq, and Nasr. They prayed to them, even though statues cannot see, hear, or help anyone.

So Allah sent a kind and patient messenger from among them: Nuh. Nuh said: O my people, worship Allah alone. Ask your Lord to forgive you, for He is always Forgiving. He will send you rain from the sky, and give you wealth, children, gardens, and rivers. He told them: Look at the sky! Allah made the moon a light, and the sun a shining lamp. Look at the earth, spread out for you like a carpet, with wide paths to walk on.

Nuh called his people by night, and by day. He spoke loudly to crowds, and quietly to people one by one. But they put their fingers in their ears, and covered themselves with their clothes, so they would not hear. Did Nuh give up? No! He kept trying for nine hundred and fifty years! And he never asked for money. He said: My reward is only from Allah.

Only a few people believed. Many of them were poor. The proud chiefs laughed: Only the lowest of us follow you! They wanted Nuh to send them away. But Nuh said: I will never drive away those who believe. To Allah, the best person is not the richest. It is the one with the best heart. So let's be kind to everyone!

Then Allah told Nuh that no more of his people would believe, and said: Build the ship, under Our eyes, and with Our guidance. So Nuh built a huge ship of wooden planks and nails, on dry land, far from any sea! Every time the chiefs walked past, they made fun of him. But Nuh kept working, trusting Allah completely.

Then Allah's command came, and water burst up from the earth! Allah said: Carry in the ship a pair of every kind of animal, your family, except those who refused to believe, and the believers. And Nuh said: Climb aboard! Bismillahi majraha wa mursaha. In the name of Allah it sails, and in the name of Allah it stops.

The gates of the sky opened with pouring rain, and springs burst from the ground. The ark sailed through waves as big as mountains. Nuh saw his own son standing apart, and called: O my son, come with us! But his son said: I will climb a mountain. It will keep me safe. Nuh replied: Today nothing can save anyone from Allah's command, except His mercy. Then a wave came between them, and his son was not saved. Mountains and strength cannot save us. Only Allah's mercy can.

Then it was said: O earth, swallow your water! O sky, hold back your rain! The water went down, and the ark came to rest on Mount Judi. Allah said: O Nuh, come down in peace from Us, with blessings on you, and on the believers with you.

Allah left this story as a sign for us. So, will we remember? What did we learn from Prophet Nuh? One: never give up doing good, and be patient. Two: be kind to every person, rich or poor. Three: trust Allah, even when others laugh at you. Let's say Nuh's beautiful dua together: Rabbighfir li wa li walidayya. My Lord, forgive me and my parents.
This week's Kindness Challenge: be patient with someone, even when it's hard! See you next time, on Toon Noon!
